FN-HG1H568-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 37
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 37 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal
general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds,
municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase
the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of
Corrections, the Board of Pardons and Paroles, and community corrections programs by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the
offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Page 1

FN-HG1H568-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 37
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/28/2026
House Bill 37 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary could increase receipts to the State
General Fund fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, and
other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State
General Fund, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, the Board of Pardons and
Paroles, and community corrections programs by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the
penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could increase the obligations of certain municipalities by an undetermined
amount dependent on the cost to reimburse certain county commissions for medical expenses
when an individual is arrested by a municipal law enforcement agency, for offenses pursuant to
this bill, and detained in a county jail.
